raw_html: [[Occasional Overcooling]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Occasional Overcooling]]:''' Your shots from this Rune Arm have a 15% chance of freezing your target solid for six seconds. ([[Fortitude Save]] negates, DC is equal to your Rune Arm shots, +2 per Charge Tier the shot was fired at).
